cmd: git ls-files && echo --- && cat -n $(git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)(account|users)\.py$') ; echo ---; ls tests 2>/dev/null; cat -n tests/*.py 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat > account.py <<'EOF'
from users import get_user


def health():
    return "ok"


def account_summary(uid):
    user = get_user(uid)
    return f"User {user['id']}"
EOF
cat > tests/test_account.py <<'EOF'
from account import account_summary


def test_account_summary():
    assert account_summary(7) == "User 7"
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -20; git status --short
